title: User namespaces in the Linux sandbox, tool search retry fix
headline: A new setting lets sandboxed Linux commands create user namespaces, requests no longer all fail when a provider rejects tool search, and many smaller fixes land.

lines.text: Linux sandbox: the new sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces setting lets sandboxed commands create user namespaces, which Chromium and rootless podman need. With it on, those commands can also get around the sandbox's file protections.
Unattended retry mode (CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG) can now spot a usage limit that was lifted early, using the new CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS variable.

allowedMcpServers stops filtering stdio servers in managed-mcp.json that use ${VAR} only in env, so such a server your allowlist left out now loads after the upgrade. Use deniedMcpServers to keep it off.
When managed settings set allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly, plugins mounted by path from Claude Desktop lose their allowed-tools.
Deleting from /artifacts now asks with numbered choices: 1 or Enter keeps it, 2 deletes it, Esc cancels; y and n do nothing there.
A mod's docked pane is capped at 45% of the terminal width, including a width carried over from a wider terminal.
/usage turns each warning into a one-line fix that names where it comes from, and f applies the fixes. VS Code and /doctor offer the same fixes.
MCP consent dialogs are less likely to read an Enter you meant for the prompt as Accept.
A mod's Image now draws its picture in iTerm2 3.5 or later with fullscreen rendering, where only the alt text appeared before.
Remote Control: pressing w confirms that the spawn mode is saved for the folder, and a later claude remote-control start that uses it says where the mode came from.

On Vertex, Bedrock and other providers, requests no longer all fail when the endpoint or a gateway rejects tool search, or when ToolSearch is disallowed or missing from --tools. Claude Code now retries without it. This broke in 2.1.304.
/effort and /autocompact values now apply even when the model name matches a modelOverrides entry only up to letter case or a [1m] suffix.
Worktrees: new ones in a bare repository start from the default branch instead of sometimes from local HEAD, and unchanged subagent worktrees get cleaned up.
On a full disk, a failed Bash command now says the disk is full and that nothing ran, instead of showing a raw ENOSPC path.
An MCP server supplied by a cloud session or by the SDK's setMcpServers is no longer replaced mid-session by a server with the same name from your own settings.
When a subagent switches to a fallback model, Claude now names the model that actually did the work.
If compaction had to drop the oldest messages to fit its summary, cloud sessions and teammates now tell Claude.
More cases fixed where scheduled Cowork cloud sessions waited five minutes per subagent for a WebFetch URL approval that no one was present to give.
Resuming a Workflow takes finished pipeline() and parallel() agents from the run's journal instead of running them again.
Remote Control no longer leaves blank "(session)" entries in /resume after you switch conversations with /resume.
/usage rows are no longer truncated in narrow terminals.
The logo area is clean at startup again: warnings are written to the debug log, and permission rules with no effect are flagged in rows below the banner.
Screen reader mode: search boxes are read as "Search:" instead of a symbol name, and highlighted prompt text such as Ctrl+R matches or "ultrathink" no longer has spaces inside words.

Self-hosted runners: a start script that shares only stdout no longer fails with "Resource temporarily unavailable" when TERM is set (broken since 2.1.300), repository access works again when a git credential helper or askpass reads its settings through GIT_CONFIG (broken since 2.1.296), and a spawn-runner hook is no longer reported as timed out when a background runner keeps its output open.
VS Code: a "Running start-up hooks" spinner status, also announced to screen readers, appears while SessionStart or Setup hooks run.
VS Code: "Compacting..." is no longer cut short when your spinnerVerbs setting swaps in short verbs.
VS Code: when a session fails to start in time and no hook is running, the message now starts with the output logs and lists possible causes rather than pointing at sign-in and network.
Cloud sessions: admins can save existing environments on the Cloud environments page again without a false "installs packages" error.
Cloud sessions: deleting a self-hosted environment now explains what stops the delete and what it would affect.
Claude Tag: the admin Add place search now lists public Slack channels Claude hasn't joined, so admins can set them up from there.

Claude Tag: a repository that moved to another GitHub account can be added to access bundles again, a routine in a Slack DM thread keeps posting after another routine there restarts the conversation, and thread routines that would claim success without posting after a conversation ended are skipped, with their creator told.
Claude Tag: in large organizations, admin pages let you edit plugins, skills and bundles before the channel list finishes loading.
Code Review: when several pushes land on a pull request during a review, the newest commit is no longer sometimes skipped.
Code Review: a re-review no longer starts with LGTM while blocking findings from before are still open.
